apiRetry: A request to the AI service failed; retrying
apiRetryAttempt: A request to the AI service failed; retrying (attempt {attempt})
apiRetryNoResponse: No response from the AI service: the connection failed, dropped or timed out
apiRetryNoResponseWaited: No response from the AI service after {seconds} s: the connection failed, dropped or timed out
catchingUp: Catching up on the conversation from while this channel was disconnected; starting shortly
catchingUpDetail: It starts on its own once that is done. No need to resend.
cliModelLimitReached: This model's quota is used up
cliModelLimitReachedHint: Switch to another model, or wait for the quota to reset. Retrying will not help.
ownLimitWaiting: Usage limit reached. It resets in about {minutes} min, and the work continues then
ownLimitResume: The usage window has reset. Go on with what the usage limit stopped.
ownerMachineAway: The computer Claude Code runs on is offline. The work continues when it is back
ownAgentConnectionGone: {agent}'s model connection is unavailable in this team, so it won't start work. Once {owner} restores or replaces the connection in the team's model settings, call it again
cliProviderOverloaded: The AI service is overloaded right now; this step did not finish
cliProviderOverloadedHint: This is a problem on the service's side and usually clears up quickly. You can retry later.
cliSubscriptionAccountsCooling: Every Claude subscription account on the platform is rate-limited; this step did not finish
cliSubscriptionAccountsCoolingHint: The subscription accounts have reached their usage limits and cannot be called until the limits reset, which takes anywhere from minutes to days; a retry before then fails straight away. If you cannot wait, switch to a model that does not run on the subscription.
cliControlPlaneUnavailable: The platform's own service was briefly unreachable; this step did not finish
cliControlPlaneUnavailableHint: A temporary problem on the platform's side — not a spent balance, so nothing needs topping up. It usually clears up quickly; retry in a moment.
cliSubscriptionEgressOffline: The subscription's egress machine is offline; this step did not finish
cliSubscriptionEgressOfflineHint: The platform's Claude subscription can only reach the internet through this machine, so models on the subscription cannot be called while it is offline. Retry once it is back online, or switch to another model for now.
cliProviderUnreachable: Could not reach the AI service; this step did not finish
cliProviderUnreachableHint: The model service is still unreachable. Someone needs to check this environment's tunnel or relay connection before work can continue.
turnResumeWaitRateLimited: The model service is rate-limiting requests. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitOverloaded: The model service is busy. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitStreamEnded: The model connection ended early. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitUnreachable: The model service cannot be reached right now. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitEgressOffline: The model service network is unavailable. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitSubscriptionCooling: The model subscription is cooling down. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitQuotaReset: The model quota is temporarily used up. Work will continue automatically in about {minutes} min.
turnResumeWaitRunnerReplaced: The platform was updated and {agent} has to reconnect; the work it was in the middle of picks up again within {minutes} min
turnResumeExhausted: Automatic continuation attempts are exhausted. Retry manually.
turnResumeNoReset: The model quota has no known reset time. A person needs to check it.
turnResumeDeliveryFailed: Automatic continuation could not start. Retry manually.
turnResumeCanceled: Automatic continuation was canceled because the conversation changed.
cliResponseTruncated: The last reply was not sent in full
cliResponseTruncatedHint: The last reply may be incomplete; retrying lets it continue.
cliToolUnavailableHint: The tool is waiting for permission, but the prompt appeared in the container's terminal, where nobody in the channel can answer it. The tool setup in this environment is wrong and someone needs to check it; retrying will not change anything.
contextCompactRunning: The conversation is too long, so the context is being compacted; work resumes afterwards, with no replies in the meantime
contextCompactSessionEnded: This run ended before the context was compacted
deliveryChecking: Your input is recorded and its delivery is being checked; it will not be sent twice
deliveryFallback: The message could not join the work in progress and has been queued
deliveryFallbackDetail: The message is saved and the platform will handle it from the queue. No need to resend.
deviceWaiting: Waiting for the environment to connect
dispatchUnknown: Tool calls with no result: {count}. The platform will not retry them on its own
dispatchUnknownDetail: These calls were sent, but the environment never returned a result, so only that environment knows whether they ran: {calls}. Resending them automatically could apply a change that already took effect a second time. Once you have checked, you can retry and it will continue from there.
environmentFailedSetup: Preparing the environment failed in the setup script. Fix it and retry, and this picks up here
environmentFailedStartup: Preparing the environment failed in the startup script. Fix it and retry, and this picks up here
harnessNotDeployed: {harness} is not installed in this channel's environment, so nothing started.
hostFailureDetail:
Failed {count} times in a row with “{title}”.
{then}
hostUnreachable: Nothing started: this channel's device cannot be reached.
hostUnreachableDetail: Project files and committed changes are all still there. Retry once this device reconnects. The channel will not move to another device, so its working directory stays consistent.
machineQuarantined: Computer “{name}” keeps failing and has been taken out of use
machineQuarantinedNext: The channel stays on this computer; the platform waits for it to recover and will not move to another one. Retry once the computer is back.
mcpNotConnected: {server} needs to be connected in the project settings
memoryDreamChanged: Memory cleanup: shared project memory entries changed: {count}
memoryDreamRefused: Memory cleanup was skipped this time: it would have deleted more entries than the limit allows
memoryDreamRefusedDetail: When one cleanup would delete more than half of a scope's memories and more than 3 of them, the platform treats it as something gone wrong rather than a cleanup: nothing was written this time, and no memory was lost. Record ID `{run_id}`
memoryRefused: Some changes were overwritten by the platform's version; reread before writing again
memoryRejected: Over the length limit and not written: {count}
mentionUnknownMember: Could not notify {member}: not a member of this project
refUnknownConversation: {ref} points to no channel, task or thread in this project; readers see a reference that opens nothing
messageUndeliveredStale: Message not delivered after waiting {minutes} min
messageUndeliveredStaleDetail: Nothing shows the message arrived. It has waited too long for an automatic resend to still make sense. To continue, retry; the earlier messages go along with it.
noFirstOutput: No output within {seconds} s, so this did not start. The platform will not retry on its own.
noFirstOutputDetail: No model output and no tool call within {seconds} s, so the environment is treated as never having started. Common causes: an expired model subscription login (sign in again on the device), a container that could not be created, a full disk, or no connection to the model. The task never started, so no files were changed. The platform will not retry on its own, because a retry would hit the same environment. Someone needs to check the environment (container, disk, model connection); retry once it is fixed.
promptReplayed: These messages ({count}) have now been sent for handling {attempt} times, and the earlier attempts did not finish{oldest}.
promptReplayedOldestImage: ; the oldest is an image from [{author}]
promptUndelivered: Nothing started: the message never reached the AI teammate, and there was no response.
promptUndeliveredDetail: This is not an AI service problem; the request never reached the model. The message was sent to Claude Code running in the environment, but it did not take it. Usually it is stuck on a screen waiting for an answer, or its terminal has closed. Files in the workspace and finished changes are unaffected. Retrying starts it again; if it happens several times in a row, forward this notice to an admin.
resendAfterDeploy: A platform update interrupted the last run before the message arrived; it has been sent again
resendAfterToolsLost: The platform tools disconnected last time and the reply never reached the channel; reconnected and sent again
resendInterrupted: A platform restart interrupted the last resend; the message was not delivered
resendInterruptedDetail: A message is resent only once, never in an automatic loop. Finished changes are all in the workspace; to continue, retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
runnerUnresponsive: {harness}'s runner has not answered for {seconds} s
sessionReplacedForUpgrade: A platform update interrupted what {agent} was doing; the files it changed are all still there, and a retry picks the work up again
upgradeMessageWaits: The platform is updating. {agent} will handle your message after finishing its current work
runtimeImageMissing: Nothing started yet; the platform is preparing the environment again.
runtimeImageMissingDetail: Nothing had started, and project files are untouched. Retry in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact an admin.
runtimeImageMissingTitle: The environment's image is temporarily unavailable
sessionStartDockerUnavailable: Docker in the environment is not running or cannot be reached
sessionStartExecutorFailed: the container it runs in could not be created
sessionStartExecutorImageMissing: the environment is missing the image for the container it runs in
sessionStartExecutorNameTaken: the previous container has not been cleaned up yet
sessionStartFailedTitle: The AI teammate did not start
sessionStartModelLogin: the model service login has expired; an admin needs to sign in again
sessionStartPlatformCredential: the platform rejected the authorization for this start
sessionStartPlatformError: the platform returned an error during startup
sessionStartProgramBroken: a program in the environment cannot run; it may be damaged or built for another platform
sessionStartProgramCannotRun: {name} in the environment cannot run; it may be damaged or built for another platform
sessionStartProgramMissing: the environment is missing a program it needs
sessionStartRunnerBusy: the program from this channel's previous run has not exited yet
sessionStartTimeout: it did not come up within the wait limit; the startup log is in the activity view
sessionStartUnknown: the cause was not recognised; the startup log is in the activity view
sessionStartWorkMachineOffline: this channel's environment is not connected
sessionStartWorkMachinePreparing: this channel's environment is still being prepared
sessionStartWorkMachineRefused: could not get this channel's environment
sessionStartWorkMachineUnbound: the computer chosen for this channel has been unbound; choose an environment again
sessionStartingMessageQueued: The AI teammate is starting; the message is waiting and will be sent automatically
storageExhausted: The environment is out of disk space. Work is paused while the platform cleans up.
storageExhaustedDetail: Project files and finished changes are all still there. Retry once the cleanup is done; if it keeps happening, contact an admin.
storageExhaustedTitle: The environment is out of disk space
subscriptionCredentialExpired: Nothing started: the model subscription login has expired and needs signing in again.
subscriptionCredentialExpiredDetail: Someone with access to the device needs to sign in again on it (claude setup-token, or restore .credentials.json). This is not a container, disk or network problem, and the task never started, so no files were changed. Retrying will not help; once signed in again, the next message is handled normally.
subscriptionCredentialExpiredTitle: The model subscription login has expired
toolsRecovered: The platform tools disconnected and the last reply never reached the channel; reconnected and resending now
toolsRecoveredDetail: It is resent only once. The last reply never reached the channel.
turnCrashed: This stopped unexpectedly. The platform will not retry on its own
turnCrashedDetail: Finished changes are all still there. A failure like this is usually a platform bug that a retry could trigger again, so the platform will not retry on its own. Someone needs to read the logs to find the problem; once it is fixed, retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
turnFailedOutOfCredit: Stopped before finishing: the platform's AI service is out of credit for now
turnFailedOutOfCreditHint: The platform's administrators have been notified; there is nothing for you to top up. Press Retry once they have restored the credit.
turnFailedOwnOutOfCredit: Stopped before finishing: the AI service you connected has run out of balance
turnFailedOwnOutOfCreditHint: Top up the balance, or switch to another AI service. Retrying will not help.
turnFailedRequestRefusedHint: The model service rejected this request as invalid, most likely because the conversation holds something it does not accept, such as an image it cannot decode. Retrying sends the same conversation again and fails the same way; an administrator needs to look at it.
turnFailedRetryLater: Files already changed are still there. You can retry later.
turnLimit: This hit its time limit and was stopped.
turnLimitDetail: This is not an error from the AI service; the work did not finish within its time limit. Usually a command never returned, or the AI teammate is stuck on a screen waiting for an answer. Finished changes are all in the workspace. Retrying picks up where it stopped; if the same work keeps timing out, split it into smaller pieces.
turnLimitTitle: This hit its time limit and was stopped
turnResumeAfterFailure: Your work just now was cut short by a temporary model-service failure. The platform has resumed it: pick up where it stopped, without redoing what is already done.
turnQueued: The project is running as many AI tasks as it can at once; this one is queued
turnQueuedBehind: The project is running as many AI tasks as it can at once; this one is queued, {ahead} ahead of it
turnQueuedHostBusy: The platform is busy; this is queued
turnQueuedHostBusyDetail: It starts on its own once resources free up. No need to resend.
turnQueuedDetail: It starts on its own once the ones ahead finish. No need to resend.
turnResent: The platform resent the last message
turnTimeoutDetail: It has stopped; files already changed are still there. Any further output still shows here.
turnWedged: The last run produced no output for {minutes} min and was stopped
turnWedgedDetail: Finished changes are all in the workspace. The platform will not retry on its own, because a retry would go back to the environment that just failed. Once someone has checked it, you can retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
workspaceVcsPerms: Nothing started: the workspace repository has the wrong permissions.
workspaceVcsPermsDetail: The repository directory belongs to another system user, so the platform cannot access it. Project files, committed changes and history are unaffected. An admin needs to change the owner once on the machine (deploy/fix-workspace-ownership.sh); the platform cannot do it by itself. Forward this notice to an admin and retry once it is fixed.
workspaceVcsPermsTitle: Wrong permissions on the workspace repository
roomFilesKept: Files from this conversation's earlier working folder are kept until {date} and then deleted. To get them back, contact the platform administrator.
roomFileEditorSaved: {who} saved {path} in the editor, and {agent} was told
roomFileEditorSavedAside: {path} had changed when {who} saved, so this copy was saved as {aside}, and {agent} was told
ownAgentRoomConsent: I was added to {room} (room ID: {room_id}). May I participate? I will wait for your approval before acting there.
